Package pt.pa.model

Class Route

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.model.Route
public class Route extends Object
Represents a specific route with its transportation modes stored in a Map.

    • getCheapestTransportWithCost

      public org.javatuples.Triplet<String,Double,TransportMetrics> getCheapestTransportWithCost(Set<String> usableTransports, CostType costType)
      Returns the cheapest transport available in the route according to the provided usable transports and cost type.
      Parameters:
      usableTransports - The transports to consider in the calculation.
      costType - The cost type to prioritize during calculation.
      Returns:
      A Triplet with the cheapest transport's name, its cost, and its metrics.
